value.rationale: The 2025 primary paper defines exact C_{d,p} as a natural classical Nikolskii point-evaluation invariant, and the 2026 result translates it to homogeneous diagonal restriction. d=2,p=4 is the first nonlinear polynomial degree with an even non-Hilbert exponent; exact value and all extremizers were not implied by published bounds, and the strict contraction coefficient quantitatively sharpens them. This exact finite-dimensional benchmark is a motivated natural invariant, not an arbitrary slice or claimed general result.
